kylin.summary:
Apache Kylin is an open source, distributed Analytical Data Warehouse
for Big Data; it was designed to provide OLAP (Online Analytical
Processing) capability in the big data era. By renovating the multi-
dimensional cube and precalculation technology on Hadoop and Spark,
Kylin is able to achieve near constant query speed regardless of the
ever-growing data volume. Reducing query latency from minutes to sub-
second, Kylin brings online analytics back to big data.

kynema.name: kynema
kynema.summary:
Kynema is a suite of general purpose fluid dynamics simulation codes for
coupling structured and unstructured grids with overset. It also
includes a flexible multi-body solver

kynema-fmb.name: kynema-fmb
kynema-fmb.summary: An open-source performance-oriented structural dynamics simulation code.

kynema-sgf.name: kynema-sgf
kynema-sgf.summary:
Kynema-SGF is a massively parallel, block-structured adaptive-mesh,
incompressible flow solver for the Kynema project.

kynema-ugf.name: kynema-ugf
kynema-ugf.summary: Kynema-UGF: Unstructured fluid dynamics solver in the Kynema project.

kyotocabinet.name: kyotocabinet
kyotocabinet.summary: Kyoto Cabinet is a library of routines for managing a database.

ladot.name: ladot
ladot.summary:
Ladot is a script that makes using LaTeX in graphs generated by dot
(graphviz) relatively easy.

laghos.name: laghos
laghos.summary:
Laghos (LAGrangian High-Order Solver) is a CEED miniapp that solves the
time-dependent Euler equations of compressible gas dynamics in a moving
Lagrangian frame using unstructured high-order finite element spatial
discretization and explicit high-order time-stepping.

lame.name: lame
lame.summary:
LAME is a high quality MPEG Audio Layer III (MP3) encoder licensed under
the LGPL.

lammps.name: lammps
lammps.summary:
LAMMPS stands for Large-scale Atomic/Molecular Massively Parallel
Simulator.

landsfcutil.name: landsfcutil
landsfcutil.summary:
Utility routines useful for initializing land-surface states in NCEP
models. This is part of NOAA's NCEPLIBS project.

lanl-cmake-modules.name: lanl-cmake-modules
lanl-cmake-modules.summary: CMake modules for projects that have not yet adopted modern CMake.

lapack.name: veclibfort
lapack.summary:
Lightweight but flexible shim designed to rectify the incompatibilities
between the Accelerate/vecLib BLAS and LAPACK libraries shipped with
macOS and FORTRAN code compiled with modern compilers such as GNU
Fortran.

lapackpp.name: lapackpp
lapackpp.summary:
LAPACK++: C++ API for the LAPACK Linear Algebra Package. Developed by
the Innovative Computing Laboratory at the University of Tennessee,
Knoxville.

last.name: last
last.summary:
LAST finds similar regions between sequences, and aligns them. It is
designed for comparing large datasets to each other (e.g. vertebrate
genomes and/or large numbers of DNA reads).

lastz.name: lastz
lastz.summary: LASTZ is a program for aligning DNA sequences, a pairwise aligner.

latex2html.name: latex2html
latex2html.summary:
LaTeX2HTML is a utility that converts LaTeX documents to web pages in
HTML.

latte.name: latte
latte.summary: Open source density functional tight binding molecular dynamics.

launchmon.name: launchmon
launchmon.summary:
Software infrastructure that enables HPC run-time tools to co-locate
tool daemons with a parallel job.

laynii.name: laynii
laynii.summary: Stand alone fMRI software suite for layer-fMRI analyses.

lazygit.name: lazygit
lazygit.summary: A simple terminal UI for git commands

lazyten.name: lazyten
lazyten.summary: Lightweight linear algebra library based on lazy matrices

lbann.name: lbann
lbann.summary:
LBANN: Livermore Big Artificial Neural Network Toolkit. A distributed
memory, HPC-optimized, model and data parallel training toolkit for deep
neural networks.

lbfgspp.name: lbfgspp
lbfgspp.summary: A Header-only C++ Library for L-BFGS and L-BFGS-B Algorithms

lbxproxy.name: lbxproxy
lbxproxy.summary:
lbxproxy accepts client connections, multiplexes them over a single
connection to the X server, and performs various optimizations on the X
protocol to make it faster over low bandwidth and/or high latency
connections. Note that the X server source from X.Org no longer supports
the LBX extension, so this program is only useful in connecting to older
X servers.

lc-framework.name: lc-framework
lc-framework.summary:
a framework for automatically creating high-speed lossless and error-
bounded lossy data compression and decompression algorithms.

lcals.name: lcals
lcals.summary:
LCALS ("Livermore Compiler Analysis Loop Suite") is a collection of loop
kernels based, in part, on historical "Livermore Loops" benchmarks (See
the 1986 technical report: "The Livermore Fortran Kernels: A Computer
Test of the Numerical Performance Range", by Frank H. McMahon,
UCRL-53745.). The suite contains facilities to generate timing
statistics and reports.

lcc.name: lcc
lcc.summary:
Los Alamos Crystal Cut (LCC) is a simple crystal builder. It is an easy-
to-use and easy-to-develop code to make crystal solid/shape and slabs
from a crystal lattice. Provided you have a ‘.pdb‘ file containing your
lattice basis you can create a solid or slab from command line.

lcgenv.name: lcgenv
lcgenv.summary: This package provides environment for packages in SFT LCG releases.

lcio.name: lcio
lcio.summary: HEP Library for Linear Collider Input/Output

lcms.name: lcms
lcms.summary:
Little cms is a color management library. Implements fast transforms
between ICC profiles. It is focused on speed, and is portable across
several platforms (MIT license).

lcov.name: lcov
lcov.summary:
LCOV is a graphical front-end for GCC's coverage testing tool gcov. It
collects gcov data for multiple source files and creates HTML pages
containing the source code annotated with coverage information. It also
adds overview pages for easy navigation within the file structure. LCOV
supports statement, function and branch coverage measurement.

ldak.name: ldak
ldak.summary: LDAK is a software package for analyzing GWAS data

licenses: BSD-3-Clause AND BSL-1.0 AND ( Artistic-1.0 OR GPL-2.0-or-later ) AND NCSA AND MIT
ldc.name: ldc
ldc.summary:
The LDC project aims to provide a portable D programming language
compiler with modern optimization and code generation capabilities. LDC
is fully Open Source; the parts of the code not taken/adapted from other
projects are BSD-licensed (see the LICENSE file for details). Consult
the D wiki for further information: https://wiki.dlang.org/LDC

ldc-bootstrap.name: ldc-bootstrap
ldc-bootstrap.summary:
The LDC project aims to provide a portable D programming language
compiler with modern optimization and code generation capabilities. LDC
is fully Open Source; the parts of the code not taken/adapted from other
projects are BSD-licensed (see the LICENSE file for details). Consult
the D wiki for further information: https://wiki.dlang.org/LDC This old
version of the compiler is needed to bootstrap newer ones.

ldsc.name: ldsc
ldsc.summary:
ldsc is a command line tool for estimating heritability and genetic
correlation from GWAS summary statistics. ldsc also computes LD scores

lean4.name: lean4
lean4.summary:
Lean 4 programming language and theorem prover. Lean is an open-source
programming language and proof assistant that enables correct,
maintainable, and formally verified code.

legion.name: legion
legion.summary:
Legion is a data-centric parallel programming system for writing
portable high performance programs targeted at distributed heterogeneous
architectures. Legion presents abstractions which allow programmers to
describe properties of program data (e.g. independence, locality). By
making the Legion programming system aware of the structure of program
data, it can automate many of the tedious tasks programmers currently
face, including correctly extracting task- and data-level parallelism
and moving data around complex memory hierarchies. A novel mapping
interface provides explicit programmer controlled placement of data in
the memory hierarchy and assignment of tasks to processors in a way that
is orthogonal to correctness, thereby enabling easy porting and tuning
of Legion applications to new architectures.

lemon.name: lemon
lemon.summary:
LEMON stands for Library for Efficient Modeling and Optimization in
Networks. It is a C++ template library providing efficient
implementations of common data structures and algorithms with focus on
combinatorial optimization tasks connected mainly with graphs and
networks.

leptonica.name: leptonica
leptonica.summary:
Leptonica is an open source library containing software that is broadly
useful for image processing and image analysis applications.

lerc.name: lerc
lerc.summary:
Limited Error Raster Compression. LERC is an open-source image or raster
format which supports rapid encoding and decoding for any pixel type
(not just RGB or Byte). Users set the maximum compression error per
pixel while encoding, so the precision of the original input image is
preserved (within user defined error bounds).

less.name: less
less.summary:
The less utility is a text file browser that resembles more, but has
more capabilities. Less allows you to move backwards in the file aswell
as forwards.

lesstif.name: lesstif
lesstif.summary: LessTif is the Hungry Programmers' version of OSF/Motif.

leveldb.name: leveldb
leveldb.summary:
LevelDB is a fast key-value storage library written at Google that
provides an ordered mapping from string keys to string values.

lftp.name: lftp
lftp.summary:
LFTP is a sophisticated file transfer program supporting a number of
network protocols (ftp, http, sftp, fish, torrent).

lhapdf.name: lhapdf
lhapdf.summary:
LHAPDF is a general purpose C++ interpolator, used for evaluating PDFs
from discretised data files.

lhapdf5.name: lhapdf5
lhapdf5.summary:
LHAPDF is a general purpose Fortran 77/90 interpolator, used for
evaluating PDFs from discretised data files.

lhapdfsets.name: lhapdfsets
lhapdfsets.summary:
A set of disretised data files of parton density functions , to be used
with the LHAPDF library

libabigail.name: libabigail
libabigail.summary: The ABI Generic Analysis and Instrumentation Library

libaec.name: libaec
libaec.summary:
Libaec provides fast lossless compression of 1 up to 32 bit wide signed
or unsigned integers (samples). It implements Golomb-Rice compression
method under the BSD license and includes a free drop-in replacement for
the SZIP library.

libaio.name: libaio
libaio.summary:
Linux native Asynchronous I/O interface library. AIO enables even a
single application thread to overlap I/O operations with other
processing, by providing an interface for submitting one or more I/O
requests in one system call (io_submit()) without waiting for
completion, and a separate interface (io_getevents()) to reap completed
I/O operations associated with a given completion group.

libapplewm.name: libapplewm
libapplewm.summary:
AppleWM is a simple library designed to interface with the Apple-WM
extension. This extension allows X window managers to better interact
with the Mac OS X Aqua user interface when running X11 in a rootless
mode.

libapreq2.name: libapreq2
libapreq2.summary:
httpd-apreq is subproject of the Apache HTTP Server Project whose
committers develop and maintain the libapreq C library and its language
bindings for Perl (contributions for additional language bindings are
most welcome).

libarchive.name: libarchive
libarchive.summary:
libarchive: C library and command-line tools for reading and writing
tar, cpio, zip, ISO, and other archive formats.

libasr.name: libasr
libasr.summary: libasr is a free, simple and portable asynchronous resolver library.

libassuan.name: libassuan
libassuan.summary: Libassuan is a small library implementing the so-called Assuan protocol.

libatasmart.name: libatasmart
libatasmart.summary:
A small and lightweight parser library for ATA S.M.A.R.T. hard disk
health monitoring.

libatomic-ops.name: libatomic-ops
libatomic-ops.summary:
This package provides semi-portable access to hardware-provided atomic
memory update operations on a number architectures.

libavif.name: libavif
libavif.summary: libavif - Library for encoding and decoding .avif files.

libbacktrace.name: libbacktrace
libbacktrace.summary:
A C library that may be linked into a C/C++ program to produce symbolic
backtraces.

libbeagle.name: libbeagle
libbeagle.summary:
BEAGLE is a high-performance library for evaluating phylogenetic
likelihoods on CPUs and GPUs, used by programs such as BEAST and
MrBayes.

libbeato.name: libbeato
libbeato.summary:
libbeato is a C library containing routines for various uses in
Genomics, and includes a copy of the freeware portion of the C library
from UCSC's Genome Browser Group.

libbeef.name: libbeef
libbeef.summary:
Library for Bayesian error estimation functionals for use in density
functional theory codes.

libbigwig.name: libbigwig
libbigwig.summary:
A C library for reading/parsing local and remote bigWig and bigBed
files.

libbinio.name: libbinio
libbinio.summary: Platform-independent way to access binary data streams in C++.

libblastrampoline.name: libblastrampoline
libblastrampoline.summary: Using PLT trampolines to provide a BLAS and LAPACK demuxing library.

libbsd.name: libbsd
libbsd.summary:
This library provides useful functions commonly found on BSD systems,
and lacking on others like GNU systems, thus making it easier to port
projects with strong BSD origins, without needing to embed the same code
over and over again on each project.

libbson.name: libbson
libbson.summary:
libbson is a library providing useful routines related to building,
parsing, and iterating BSON documents.

libbytesize.name: libbytesize
libbytesize.summary:
The goal of this project is to provide a tiny library that would
facilitate the common operations with sizes in bytes.

libc.name: musl
libc.summary:
Musl is a libc, an implementation of the standard library functionality
described in the ISO C and POSIX standards, plus common extensions,
intended for use on Linux-based systems. Whereas the kernel (Linux)
governs access to hardware, memory, filesystems, and the privileges for
accessing these resources, the C library is responsible for providing
the actual C function interfaces userspace applications see, and for
constructing higher-level buffered stdio, memory allocation management,
thread creation and synchronization operations, and so on using the
lower-level interfaces the kernel provides, as well as for implementing
pure library routines of the C language like strstr, snprintf, strtol,
exp, sqrt, etc. Musl is a new general-purpose implementation of the C
library. It is lightweight, fast, simple, free, and aims to be correct
in the sense of standards-conformance and safety.

libcanberra.name: libcanberra
libcanberra.summary:
libcanberra is an implementation of the XDG Sound Theme and Name
Specifications, for generating event sounds on free desktops, such as
GNOME.

libcap.name: libcap
libcap.summary:
Libcap implements the user-space interfaces to the POSIX 1003.1e
capabilities available in Linux kernels. These capabilities are a
partitioning of the all powerful root privilege into a set of distinct
privileges.

libcap-ng.name: libcap-ng
libcap-ng.summary: Libcap-ng is a library that makes using posix capabilities easier

libcatalyst.name: libcatalyst
libcatalyst.summary:
Catalyst is an API specification developed for simulations (and other
scientific data producers) to analyze and visualize data in situ.

libceed.name: libceed
libceed.summary: The CEED API Library: Code for Efficient Extensible Discretizations.

libcerf.name: libcerf
libcerf.summary:
A self-contained C library providing complex error functions, based on
Faddeeva's plasma dispersion function w(z). Also provides Dawson's
integral and Voigt's convolution of a Gaussian and a Lorentzian

libcifpp.name: libcifpp
libcifpp.summary: Library containing code to manipulate mmCIF and PDB files.

libcint.name: libcint
libcint.summary: Library for analytical Gaussian integrals for quantum chemistry.

libcircle.name: libcircle
libcircle.summary:
libcircle provides an efficient distributed queue on a cluster, using
self-stabilizing work stealing.

libcomm.name: libcomm
libcomm.summary: Header-only communication library used by LibRI.

libconfuse.name: libconfuse
libconfuse.summary: Small configuration file parser library for C.

libcroco.name: libcroco
libcroco.summary: Libcroco is a standalone css2 parsing and manipulation library.

libctl.name: libctl
libctl.summary:
libctl is a free Guile-based library implementing flexible control files
for scientific simulations.

libcudf.name: libcudf
libcudf.summary:
Built based on the Apache Arrow columnar memory format, cuDF is a GPU
DataFrame library for loading, joining, aggregating, filtering, and
otherwise manipulating data.

libcuml.name: libcuml
libcuml.summary:
cuML is a suite of libraries that implement machine learning algorithms
and mathematical primitives functions that share compatible APIs with
other RAPIDS projects.

libcxi.name: libcxi
libcxi.summary:
The CXI library provides interfaces which interact directly with CXI
drivers.

libcxxwrap-julia.name: libcxxwrap-julia
libcxxwrap-julia.summary:
This is the C++ library component of the CxxWrap.jl package, distributed
as a regular CMake library for use in other C++ projects.

libcyaml.name: libcyaml
libcyaml.summary:
LibCYAML is a C library for reading and writing structured YAML
documents. It is written in ISO C11 and licensed under the ISC licence.

libdaemon.name: libdaemon
libdaemon.summary:
libdaemon is a lightweight C library which eases the writing of UNIX
daemons.

libdap4.name: libdap4
libdap4.summary:
libdap4 is is a c++ library to serve as a client for the OPeNDAP
framework that simplifies all aspects of scientific data networking and
provides software which makes local data accessible to remote locations
regardless of local storage format.

libdatrie.name: libdatrie
libdatrie.summary:
datrie is an implementation of double-array structure for representing
trie.

libdc1394.name: libdc1394
libdc1394.summary: Library providing an API for IEEE 1394 cameras.

libde265.name: libde265
libde265.summary:
libde265 is an open source implementation of the h.265 video codec. It
is written from scratch and has a plain C API to enable a simple
integration into other software.

libdeflate.name: libdeflate
libdeflate.summary:
Heavily optimized library for DEFLATE/zlib/gzip compression and
decompression

libdicom.name: libdicom
libdicom.summary:
libdicom is a C library and a set of command-line tools for reading
DICOM WSI files.

libdistributed.name: libdistributed
libdistributed.summary:
a collection of facilities for MPI that create for higher level
facilities for programming in C++

libdivsufsort.name: libdivsufsort
libdivsufsort.summary:
libdivsufsort is a software library that implements a lightweight suffix
array construction algorithm.

libdmx.name: libdmx
libdmx.summary:
libdmx - X Window System DMX (Distributed Multihead X) extension
library.

libdrm.name: libdrm
libdrm.summary:
A userspace library for accessing the DRM, direct rendering manager, on
Linux, BSD and other systems supporting the ioctl interface.

libdwarf.name: libdwarf
libdwarf.summary:
The DWARF Debugging Information Format is of interest to programmers
working on compilers and debuggers (and any one interested in reading or
writing DWARF information). It was developed by a committee (known as
the PLSIG at the time) starting around 1991. Starting around 1991 SGI
developed the libdwarf and dwarfdump tools for internal use and as part
of SGI IRIX developer tools. Since that time dwarfdump and libdwarf have
been shipped (as an executable and archive respectively, not source)
with every release of the SGI MIPS/IRIX C compiler.

libeatmydata.name: libeatmydata
libeatmydata.summary:
libeatmydata is a small LD_PRELOAD library designed to (transparently)
disable fsync (and friends, like open(O_SYNC)). This has two side-
effects: making software that writes data safely to disk a lot quicker
and making this software no longer crash safe.

libecpint.name: libecpint
libecpint.summary:
A C++ library for the efficient evaluation of integrals over effective
core potentials.

libedit.name: libedit
libedit.summary: An autotools compatible port of the NetBSD editline library

libefence.name: libefence
libefence.summary:
Electric Fence (or eFence) is a memory debugger written by Bruce Perens.
It consists of a library which programmers can link into their code to
override the C standard library memory management functions. eFence
triggers a program crash when the memory error occurs, so a debugger can
be used to inspect the code that caused the error.

libelf.name: libelf
libelf.summary:
libelf lets you read, modify or create ELF object files in an
architecture-independent way. The library takes care of size and endian
issues, e.g. you can process a file for SPARC processors on an Intel-
based system. Note: libelf is no longer maintained and packages that
depend on libelf should migrate to elfutils.

libemos.name: libemos
libemos.summary:
The Interpolation library (EMOSLIB) includes Interpolation software and
BUFR & CREX encoding/decoding routines.

libepoxy.name: libepoxy
libepoxy.summary:
Epoxy is a library for handling OpenGL function pointer management for
you.

libestr.name: libestr
libestr.summary: C library for string handling (and a bit more).

libev.name: libev
libev.summary:
A full-featured and high-performance event loop that is loosely modelled
after libevent, but without its limitations and bugs.

libevdev.name: libevdev
libevdev.summary:
libevdev is a wrapper library for evdev devices. it moves the common
tasks when dealing with evdev devices into a library and provides a
library interface to the callers, thus avoiding erroneous ioctls, etc.

libevent.name: libevent
libevent.summary:
The libevent API provides a mechanism to execute a callback function
when a specific event occurs on a file descriptor or after a timeout has
been reached. Furthermore, libevent also support callbacks due to
signals or regular timeouts.

libevpath.name: libevpath
libevpath.summary:
EVpath is an event transport middleware layer designed to allow for the
easy implementation of overlay networks, with active data processing,
routing and management at all points in the overlay. EVPath is designed
for high performance systems.

libexif.name: libexif
libexif.summary: A library to parse an EXIF file and read the data from those tags

libfabric.name: libfabric
libfabric.summary:
The Open Fabrics Interfaces (OFI) is a framework focused on exporting
fabric communication services to applications.

libfastcommon.name: libfastcommon
libfastcommon.summary:
Libfastcommon is a c common functions library extracted from my open
source project FastDFS. this library is very simple and stable.
functions including: string, logger, chain, hash, socket, ini file
reader, base64 encode / decode, url encode / decode, fast timer,
skiplist, object pool etc. detail info please see the c header files.

libfastjson.name: libfastjson
libfastjson.summary: a fast json library for C.

libfci.name: libfci
libfci.summary:
libfci is a compact determinant full-CI solver library developed by
Gerald Knizia, 2010-2012, and packaged as a small C ABI for active-space
embedding workflows. The original standalone driver accepted FCIDUMP-
style Hamiltonians. The library interface bypasses file I/O and accepts
dense active-space one- and two-electron matrices using CP2K's FCIDUMP
conventions. The exported C entry point is libfci_solve. A compatibility
wrapper named cp2k_fci_solve is also exported for older CP2K integration
experiments.

libffi.name: libffi
libffi.summary:
The libffi library provides a portable, high level programming interface
to various calling conventions. This allows a programmer to call any
function specified by a call interface description at run time.

libffs.name: libffs
libffs.summary:
FFS is a middleware library for data communication, including
representation, processing and marshaling that preserves the performance
of traditional approaches while relaxing the requirement of a priori
knowledge and providing complex run-time flexibility.

libfirefly.name: libfirefly
libfirefly.summary: A standalone C++ Library for vectors calculations

libfive.name: libfive
libfive.summary: libfive is a software library and set of tools for solid modeling.

libflame.name: libflame
libflame.summary:
libflame is a portable library for dense matrix computations, providing
much of the functionality present in LAPACK, developed by current and
former members of the Science of High-Performance Computing (SHPC) group
in the Institute for Computational Engineering and Sciences at The
University of Texas at Austin. libflame includes a compatibility layer,
lapack2flame, which includes a complete LAPACK implementation.

libfort.name: libfort
libfort.summary:
libfort is a simple crossplatform library to create formatted text
tables.

libfs.name: libfs
libfs.summary:
libFS - X Font Service client library. This library is used by clients
of X Font Servers (xfs), such as xfsinfo, fslsfonts, and the X servers
themselves.

libftdi.name: libftdi
libftdi.summary:
libftdi - A library (using libusb) to talk to FTDI's UART/FIFO chips
including the popular bitbang mode

libfuse.name: libfuse
libfuse.summary:
The reference implementation of the Linux FUSE (Filesystem in Userspace)
interface

libfyaml.name: libfyaml
libfyaml.summary:
Fully feature complete YAML parser and emitter, supporting the latest
YAML spec and passing the full YAML testsuite.

libgain.name: libgain
libgain.summary:
GaIn is intended to provide routines with a relatively simple interface
for calculation of overlap, kinetic and 2,3 and 4 center Coulomb
integrals over either Solid or Cubic Harmonics Gaussian basis sets.

libgcrypt.name: libgcrypt
libgcrypt.summary: Cryptographic library based on the code from GnuPG.

libgd.name: libgd
libgd.summary:
GD is an open source code library for the dynamic creation of images by
programmers. GD is written in C, and "wrappers" are available for Perl,
PHP and other languages. GD creates PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, XPM, BMP
images, among other formats. GD is commonly used to generate charts,
graphics, thumbnails, and most anything else, on the fly. While not
restricted to use on the web, the most common applications of GD involve
website development.

libgdsii.name: libgdsii
libgdsii.summary:
libGDSII is a C++ library for working with GDSII binary data files,
intended primarily for use with the computational electromagnetism codes
scuff-em and meep but sufficiently general-purpose to allow other uses
as well.

libgee.name: libgee
libgee.summary:
Libgee is a collection library providing GObject-based interfaces and
classes for commonly used data structures.

libgeopm.name: libgeopm
libgeopm.summary:
The Global Extensible Open Power Manager (GEOPM) Runtime is designed to
enhance energy efficiency of applications through active hardware
configuration.

libgeopmd.name: libgeopmd
libgeopmd.summary:
The Global Extensible Open Power Manager (GEOPM) Service provides a user
interface for accessing hardware telemetry and settings securely. Note:
GEOPM interfaces with hardware using Model Specific Registers (MSRs).
For proper usage make sure MSRs are made available via the msr or msr-
safe kernel modules by your administrator.

libgeotiff.name: libgeotiff
libgeotiff.summary:
GeoTIFF represents an effort by over 160 different remote sensing, GIS,
cartographic, and surveying related companies and organizations to
establish a TIFF based interchange format for georeferenced raster
imagery.

libgff.name: libgff
libgff.summary:
Lightweight GTF/GFF Parser, exposes a C++ interface without drawing in a
heavyweight dependency.

libgit2.name: libgit2
libgit2.summary:
libgit2 is a portable, pure C implementation of the Git core methods
provided as a re-entrant linkable library with a solid API, allowing you
to write native speed custom Git applications in any language which
supports C bindings.

libgit2-glib.name: libgit2-glib
libgit2-glib.summary:
libgit2-glib is a glib wrapper library around the libgit2 git access
library. libgit2 only implements the core plumbing functions, not really
the higher level porcelain stuff.

libglx.name: opengl
