among other things

scine-serenity.name: scine-serenity
scine-serenity.summary: Wrapper around Serenity to make it compatible with Scine

scine-sparrow.name: scine-sparrow
scine-sparrow.summary:
Sparrow: fast semiempirical quantum chemical calculations. When
publishing results obtained with Sparrow, please cite the corresponding
release as archived on Zenodo (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.3244105; please use
the DOI of the respective release). In addition, we kindly request you
to cite the following article when using Sparrow: T. Husch, A. C.
Vaucher, M. Reiher, "Semiempirical molecular orbital models based on the
neglect of diatomic differential overlap approximation", Int. J. Quantum

scine-utilities.name: scine-utilities

The SCIP Optimization Suite is a toolbox for generating and solving
mixed integer nonlinear programs, in particular mixed integer linear
programs, and constraint integer programs Note: A manual download is
required for SCIP. Spack will search your current directory for the
download file. Alternatively, add this file to a mirror so that Spack

https://spack.readthedocs.io/en/latest/mirrors.html

MIT Screen Saver Extension. This extension defines a protocol to control
screensaver features and also to query screensaver info on specific
windows.

scrot.name: scrot
scrot.summary:
scrot (SCReenshOT) is a simple command line screen capture utility that
uses imlib2 to grab and save images. Multiple image formats are
supported through imlib2's dynamic saver modules.

scs.name: scs
scs.summary: A C package that solves convex cone problems via operator splitting

sctk.name: sctk
sctk.summary:
The NIST Scoring Toolkit (SCTK) is a collection of software tools
designed to score benchmark test evaluations of Automatic Speech
Recognition (ASR) Systems. The toolkit is currently used by NIST,
benchmark test participants, and reserchers worldwide to as a common
scoring engine.

sdl2.name: sdl2
sdl2.summary:
Simple DirectMedia Layer is a cross-platform development library
designed to provide low level access to audio, keyboard, mouse,
joystick, and graphics hardware via OpenGL and Direct3D.

sdl2-image.name: sdl2-image
sdl2-image.summary:
SDL is designed to provide the bare bones of creating a graphical
program.

succinct data structures.

seacas.name: seacas
seacas.summary:
The SEACAS Project contains the Exodus and IOSS I/O libraries and a
collection of applications which create, query, modify, or translate
Exodus databases. Exodus is a finite element mesh and results database
file format. Default is to build the Exodus and IOSS libraries and the

seacr.name: seacr
seacr.summary:
SEACR (Sparse Enrichment Analysis for CUT&RUN) is intended to call peaks
and enriched regions from sparse CUT&RUN or chromatin profiling data in

seal.name: seal
seal.summary:
Microsoft SEAL is an easy-to-use open-source (MIT licensed) homomorphic
encryption library developed by the Cryptography and Privacy Research
Group at Microsoft. Microsoft SEAL is written in modern standard C++ and
is easy to compile and run in many different environments. For more
information about the Microsoft SEAL project, see sealcrypto.org.

sed.name: sed
sed.summary: GNU implementation of the famous stream editor.

sedacs.name: sedacs
sedacs.summary:
Scalable Ecosystem, Driver, and Analyzer for Complex Chemistry
Simulations (SEDACS) enables massively parallel atomistic simulations
that can seamlessly integrate with a diverse range of available and
emerging quantum chemistry codes at different levels of theory.
Supporting ab initio, semiempirical quantum mechanics, and coarse-
grained flexible charge equilibration models, this is a unified
framework to simulate and analyze the quantum molecular dynamics of
complex chemical systems and materials.

seissol.name: seissol
seissol.summary:
Seissol - A scientific software for the numerical simulation of seismic
wave phenomena and earthquake dynamics.

selalib.name: selalib
selalib.summary:

of tokamak plasmas by the semi-lagrangian or particle-in-cell methods

sendme.summary: A cli tool to send directories over the network, with NAT hole punching

sensei.name: sensei
sensei.summary:
SENSEI is a platform for scalable in-situ analysis and visualization.
Its design motto is "Write once, run everywhere", this means that once
the application is instrumented with SENSEI it can use existing and
future analysis backends. Existing backends include: Paraview/Catalyst,
Visit/Libsim, ADIOS, Python scripts, and so on.

sentencepiece.name: sentencepiece
sentencepiece.summary:
Unsupervised text tokenizer for Neural Network-based text generation.
This is the C++ package.

sentieon-genomics.name: sentieon-genomics
sentieon-genomics.summary:
Sentieon provides complete solutions for secondary DNA analysis. Our
software improves upon BWA, GATK, Mutect, and Mutect2 based pipelines.
The Sentieon tools are deployable on any CPU-based computing system. Use
of this software is subject to the EULA at:
https://www.sentieon.com/EULA/eula-aws.html Please set the path to the
sentieon license server with: export SENTIEON_LICENSE=<FQDN>:<PORT>

sepp.name: sepp
sepp.summary: SEPP stands for SATe-enabled phylogenetic placement

seq-gen.name: seq-gen
seq-gen.summary:
Seq-Gen is a program that will simulate the evolution of nucleotide or
amino acid sequences along a phylogeny. Seq-Gen is a program that will
simulate the evolution of nucleotide or amino acid sequences along a
phylogeny, using common models of the substitution process. A range of
models of molecular evolution are implemented including the general
reversible model. State frequencies and other parameters of the model
may be given and site-specific rate heterogeneity may also be
incorporated in a number of ways. Any number of trees may be read in and
the program will produce any number of data sets for each tree. Thus
large sets of replicate simulations can be easily created. It has been
designed to be a general purpose simulator that incorporates most of the
commonly used (and computationally tractable) models of molecular
sequence evolution.

seqan.name: seqan
seqan.summary:
SeqAn is an open source C++ library of efficient algorithms and data
structures for the analysis of sequences with the focus on biological
data. Our library applies a unique generic design that guarantees high
performance, generality, extensibility, and integration with other
libraries. SeqAn is easy to use and simplifies the development of new
software tools with a minimal loss of performance

seqkit.name: seqkit
seqkit.summary:
seqkit: a cross-platform and ultrafast toolkit for FASTA/Q file
manipulation

seqprep.name: seqprep
seqprep.summary:

overlapping into a single longer read.

Serialbox is a serialization library and tools for C/C++, Python3 and
Fortran. Serialbox is used in several projects for building validation
frameworks against reference runs.

sessreg.name: sessreg
sessreg.summary:
Sessreg is a simple program for managing utmp/wtmp entries for X
sessions. It was originally written for use with xdm, but may also be
used with other display managers such as gdm or kdm.

setserial.name: setserial
setserial.summary: A utility for configuring serial ports.

setxkbmap.summary:
setxkbmap is an X11 client to change the keymaps in the X server for a

sfcgal.name: sfcgal
sfcgal.summary:
SFCGAL is a C++ wrapper library around CGAL with the aim of supporting
ISO 19107:2013 and OGC Simple Features Access 1.2 for 3D operations. It
provides standard compliant geometry types and operations, that can be
accessed from its C or C++ APIs.

sfcio.name: sfcio
sfcio.summary:
The SFCIO library provides an API to read the NCEP Spectral model
surface files. This is part of the NCEPLIBS project.

sfml.name: sfml
sfml.summary:
SFML is a simple, fast, cross-platform and object-oriented multimedia
API. It provides access to windowing, graphics, audio and network. It is
written in C++ and has bindings for various languages such as C, .NET,
Ruby, Python.

sga.name: sga
sga.summary:
SGA is a de novo genome assembler based on the concept of string graphs.
The major goal of SGA is to be very memory efficient, which is achieved
by using a compressed representation of DNA sequence reads.

sgpp.name: sgpp
sgpp.summary:
SGpp is a library and framework for sparse grids in different flavors.
SGpp supports both hierarchical spatially-adaptive sparse grids and the
dimensionally-adaptive sparse grid combination technique.

shadow.name: shadow
shadow.summary:
Tools to help unprivileged users create uid and gid mappings in user
namespaces.

shadowenv.name: shadowenv
shadowenv.summary:
Shadowenv provides a way to perform a set of manipulations to the
process environment upon entering a directory in a shell. These
manipulations are reversed when leaving the directory, and there is some
limited ability to make the manipulations dynamic.

shamrock.summary: The Shamrock exascale framework for astrophysics

shapeit.name: shapeit

phasing) from genotype or sequencing data.

shapeit4.name: shapeit4

SHAPEIT4 is a fast and accurate method for estimation of haplotypes (aka
phasing) for SNP array and high coverage sequencing data.

shapelib.name: shapelib

shapemapper.summary:
ShapeMapper automates the calculation of RNA structure probing
reactivities from mutational profiling (MaP) experiments, in which
chemical adducts on RNA are detected as internal mutations in cDNA
through reverse transcription and read out by massively parallel
sequencing.

shark.name: shark
shark.summary:

executable.

sheenbidi.name: sheenbidi

a ShellCheck binary is downloaded instead of being compiled from source.

shengbte.name: shengbte

Equation for phonons.

Energy Reactions of PArticles in lepton-lepton, lepton-photon, photon-
photon, lepton-hadron and hadron-hadron collisions.

shiro.name: shiro

Apache Shiro is a powerful and easy-to-use Java security framework that
performs authentication, authorization, cryptography, and session
management. With Shiro's easy-to-understand API, you can quickly and
easily secure any application - from the smallest mobile applications to

shocklibs.name: shocklibs
shocklibs.summary: The lib for shock: An object store for scientific data.

shoremap.name: shoremap
shoremap.summary:
SHOREmap is a computational tool implementing a method that enables
simple and straightforward mapping-by-sequencing analysis. Whole genome
resequencing of pools of recombinant mutant genomes allows directly
linking phenotypic traits to causal mutations. Such an analysis, called
mapping-by-sequencing, combines classical genetic mapping and next
generation sequencing by relying on selection-induced patterns within
genome-wide allele frequency in pooled genomes.

shortstack.name: shortstack
shortstack.summary:
ShortStack is a tool developed to process and analyze smallRNA-seq data
with respect to a reference genome, and output a comprehensive and
informative annotation of all discovered small RNA genes.

showfont.name: showfont

information shown includes font information, font properties, character
metrics, and character bitmaps.

shred.name: shred

functional theory (SHRED). SHRED is a plane-wave DFT code similar to
ABINIT, VASP and Quantum Espresso.

shtns.name: shtns
shtns.summary:
SHTns is a high performance library for Spherical Harmonic Transform
written in C, aimed at numerical simulation (fluid flows, mhd, ...) in
spherical geometries.

sicer2.name: sicer2
sicer2.summary: SICER2: a redesigned and improved ChIP-seq broad peak calling tool

sickle.name: sickle
sickle.summary:

thresholds to determine when quality is sufficiently low to trim the

high enough to trim the 5'-end of reads.

sicm.name: sicm
sicm.summary: SICM: Simplified Interface to Complex Memory.

siesta.name: siesta
siesta.summary:
SIESTA performs electronic structure calculations and ab initio
molecular dynamics simulations of molecules and solids.

sigcpp.name: sigcpp
sigcpp.summary: libsigc++ : The Typesafe Callback Framework for C++

sigio.name: sigio
sigio.summary:
The SIGIO library provides an Application Program Interface for
performing I/O on the sigma restart file of the NOAA global spectral
model. This is part of the NCEPLIBS project.

signalp.name: signalp
signalp.summary:
SignalP predicts the presence and location of signal peptide cleavage
sites in amino acid sequences from different organisms: Gram-positive
bacteria, Gram-negative bacteria, and eukaryotes. Note: A manual
download is required for SignalP. Spack will search your current
directory for the download file. Alternatively, add this file to a
mirror so that Spack can find it. For instructions on how to set up a
mirror, see https://spack.readthedocs.io/en/latest/mirrors.html

signify.name: signify
signify.summary: OpenBSD tool to signs and verify signatures on files.

silo.name: silo
silo.summary:
Silo is a library for reading and writing a wide variety of scientific
data to binary, disk or memory (in-situ) files.

simde.name: simde
simde.summary:
The SIMDe header-only library provides fast, portable implementations of
SIMD intrinsics on hardware which doesn't natively support them, such as
calling SSE functions on ARM. There is no performance penalty if the
hardware supports the native implementation (e.g., SSE/AVX runs at full
speed on x86, NEON on ARM, etc.).

simdjson.name: simdjson
simdjson.summary:
simdjson is a SIMD-accelerated JSON parsing library for C++ that can
parse gigabytes of JSON text per second.

simgrid.name: simgrid
simgrid.summary:
SimGrid is a framework for developing simulators of distributed
applications targetting distributed platforms, which can in turn be used
to prototype, evaluate and compare relevant platform configurations,
system designs, and algorithmic approaches.

simmetrix-simmodsuite.name: simmetrix-simmodsuite
simmetrix-simmodsuite.summary:
Simmetrix' Simulation Modeling Suite is a set of component software
toolkits that allow developers to easily implement geometry-based
simulation applications. Each component of the Simulation Modeling Suite
is designed to address specific capabilities: | MeshSim - automatic mesh
generation | FieldSim - simulation data management | GeomSim - direct,
untranslated access to geometry from a wide variety of sources

simple-dftd3.name: simple-dftd3
simple-dftd3.summary: Simple reimplementation of the DFT-D3 dispersion correction

simplemoc.name: simplemoc
simplemoc.summary:
The purpose of this mini-app is to demonstrate the performance
characterterics and viability of the Method of Characteristics (MOC) for
3D neutron transport calculations in the context of full scale light
water reactor simulation.

simsipm.name: simsipm
simsipm.summary:
SimSiPM is a simple and easy to use C++ library providing a set of
object-oriented tools with all the functionality needed to describe and
simulate Silicon PhotonMultipliers (SiPM) sensors.

simul.name: simul
simul.summary:
simul is an MPI coordinated test of parallel filesystem system calls and
library functions.

simulationio.name: simulationio
simulationio.summary: SimulationIO: Efficient and convenient I/O for large PDE simulations

singular-factory.name: singular-factory
singular-factory.summary:
Factory is a C++ library for sparse multivariate polynomials over a
variety of coefficient domains (integers, rationals, finite fields, and
algebraic extensions). It implements efficient recursive representations
and algorithms for GCDs, resultants, Chinese remaindering, and
(absolute) factorization of multivariate polynomials. The library
exposes a convenient interface via the CanonicalForm class that uses
operator overloading to make polynomial operations feel like built-in
types. Factory was originally developed by R. Stobbe and J. Schmidt and
is currently maintained as part of the Singular project.

singularity-eos.name: singularity-eos
singularity-eos.summary:
Singularity-EOS: A collection of closure models and tools useful for
multiphysics codes.

singularity-hpc.name: singularity-hpc
singularity-hpc.summary:
Local filesystem registry for containers (intended for HPC) using Lmod
or Environment Modules. Works for users and admins.

singularityce.name: singularityce
singularityce.summary:
Singularity is a container technology focused on building portable
encapsulated environments to support "Mobility of Compute" For older
versions of Singularity (pre 3.0) you should use singularity-legacy,
which has a different install base (Autotools). Needs post-install
chmod/chown steps to enable full functionality. See package definition
or `spack-build-out.txt` build log for details, e.g. tail -15 $(spack
location -i singularityce)/.spack/spack-build-out.txt

sio.name: sio
sio.summary:
SIO is a persistency solution for reading and writing binary data in SIO
structures called record and block. SIO has originally been implemented
as persistency layer for LCIO.

sionlib.name: sionlib
sionlib.summary: Scalable I/O library for parallel access to task-local files

sirius.name: sirius
sirius.summary: Domain specific library for electronic structure calculations

skilion-onedrive.name: skilion-onedrive
skilion-onedrive.summary:
A complete tool to interact with OneDrive on Linux, developed by
Skilion, following the UNIX philosophy.

skopeo.name: skopeo
skopeo.summary:
skopeo is a command line utility that performs various operations on
container images and image repositories.

sl.name: sl
sl.summary: SL: Cure your bad habit of mistyping

slang.name: slang
slang.summary: An interpreted language and programing library.

slate.name: slate
slate.summary:
The Software for Linear Algebra Targeting Exascale (SLATE) project
provides fundamental dense linear algebra capabilities to the US
Department of Energy and to the high-performance computing (HPC)
community at large. To this end, SLATE provides basic dense matrix
operations (e.g., matrix multiplication, rank-k update, triangular
solve), linear systems solvers, least square solvers, singular value and
eigenvalue solvers.

sleef.name: sleef
sleef.summary:
SIMD Library for Evaluating Elementary Functions, vectorized libm and
DFT.

slepc.name: slepc
slepc.summary: Scalable Library for Eigenvalue Problem Computations.

slf4j.name: slf4j
slf4j.summary:
The Simple Logging Facade for Java (SLF4J) serves as a simple facade or
abstraction for various logging frameworks (e.g. java.util.logging,
logback,log4j) allowing the end user to plug in the desired logging
framework at deployment time.

slirp4netns.name: slirp4netns
slirp4netns.summary: User-mode networking for unprivileged network namespaces

sloccount.name: sloccount
sloccount.summary:
SLOCCount is a set of tools for counting physical Source Lines of Code
(SLOC) in a large number of languages of a potentially large set of
programs.

slurm.name: slurm
slurm.summary:
Slurm is an open source, fault-tolerant, and highly scalable cluster
management and job scheduling system for large and small Linux clusters.
Slurm requires no kernel modifications for its operation and is
relatively self-contained. As a cluster workload manager, Slurm has
three key functions. First, it allocates exclusive and/or non-exclusive
access to resources (compute nodes) to users for some duration of time
so they can perform work. Second, it provides a framework for starting,
executing, and monitoring work (normally a parallel job) on the set of
allocated nodes. Finally, it arbitrates contention for resources by
managing a queue of pending work.

slurm-drmaa.name: slurm-drmaa
slurm-drmaa.summary:
DRMAA for Slurm is an implementation of Open Grid Forum DRMAA 1.0
(Distributed Resource Management Application API) specification for
submission and control of jobs to Slurm. Using DRMAA, grid applications
builders, portal developers and ISVs can use the same high-level API to
link their software with different cluster/resource management systems.

smalt.name: smalt
smalt.summary: SMALT aligns DNA sequencing reads with a reference genome.

smartdenovo.name: smartdenovo
smartdenovo.summary:
SMARTdenovo is a de novo assembler for PacBio and Oxford Nanopore (ONT)
data.

smee-client.name: smee-client
smee-client.summary:
Client and CLI for smee.io, a service that delivers webhooks to your
local development environment.

smof.name: smof
smof.summary: Explore and analyze biological sequence data

smproxy.name: smproxy
smproxy.summary:
smproxy allows X applications that do not support X11R6 session
management to participate in an X11R6 session.

snakemake.name: snakemake
snakemake.summary:
Workflow management system to create reproducible and scalable data
analyses.

snap.name: snap
snap.summary:
SNAP serves as a proxy application to model the performance of a modern
discrete ordinates neutral particle transport application. SNAP may be
considered an update to Sweep3D, intended for hybrid computing
architectures. It is modeled off the Los Alamos National Laboratory code
PARTISN.

snap-berkeley.name: snap-berkeley
snap-berkeley.summary:
SNAP is a fast and accurate aligner for short DNA reads. It is optimized
for modern read lengths of 100 bases or higher, and takes advantage of
these reads to align data quickly through a hash-based indexing scheme.

snap-korf.name: snap-korf
snap-korf.summary:
SNAP is a general purpose gene finding program suitable for both
eukaryotic and prokaryotic genomes.

snbone.name: snbone
snbone.summary:
This application targets the primary computational solve burden of a SN,
continuous finite element based transport equation solver.

sniffles.name: sniffles
sniffles.summary: Structural variation caller using third generation sequencing.

sniper.name: sniper
sniper.summary:
General-purpose software framework for high-energy physics processing.
SNiPER provides event-loop control, dynamically loadable algorithms and
services, Python configuration, and optional ROOT integration. It is
used by experiments including JUNO, STCF, and HERD.

snls.name: snls
snls.summary: Small Non-Linear Solver for solving non-linear systems of equations

snpeff.name: snpeff
snpeff.summary:
SnpEff is a variant annotation and effect prediction tool. It annotates
and predicts the effects of genetic variants (such as amino acid
changes).

snphylo.name: snphylo
snphylo.summary: A pipeline to generate a phylogenetic tree from huge SNP data

snptest.name: snptest
snptest.summary:
SNPTEST is a program for the analysis of single SNP association in
genome-wide studies.

soapdenovo-trans.name: soapdenovo-trans
soapdenovo-trans.summary:
SOAPdenovo-Trans is a de novo transcriptome assembler basing on the
SOAPdenovo framework, adapt to alternative splicing and different
expression level among transcripts.

soapdenovo2.name: soapdenovo2
soapdenovo2.summary:
SOAPdenovo is a novel short-read assembly method that can build a de
novo draft assembly for the human-sized genomes. The program is
specially designed to assemble Illumina GA short reads. It creates new
opportunities for building reference sequences and carrying out accurate
analyses of unexplored genomes in a cost effective way.

socat.name: socat
socat.summary:
socat is a relay for bidirectional data transfer between two independent
data channels. Each of these data channels may be a file, pipe, device
(serial line etc. or a pseudo terminal), a socket (UNIX, IP4, IP6 - raw,
UDP, TCP), an SSL socket, proxy CONNECT connection, a file descriptor
(stdin etc.), the GNU line editor (readline), a program, or a
combination of two of these. These modes include generation of
"listening" sockets, named pipes, and pseudo terminals.

soci.name: soci
soci.summary: Official repository of the SOCI - The C++ Database Access Library

sofa-c.name: sofa-c
sofa-c.summary: Standards of Fundamental Astronomy (SOFA) library for ANSI C.

sollya.name: sollya
sollya.summary:
Sollya is both a tool environment and a library for safe floating-point
code development. It is particularily targeted to the automatized
implementation of mathematical floating-point libraries (libm). Amongst
other features, it offers a certified infinity (supremum) norm and a
fast Remez algorithm.

solr.name: solr
solr.summary:
Solr is highly reliable, scalable and fault tolerant, providing
distributed indexing, replication and load-balanced querying, automated
failover and recovery,centralized configuration and more. Solr powers
the search and navigation features of many of the world's largest
internet sites.

somatic-sniper.name: somatic-sniper
somatic-sniper.summary: A tool to call somatic single nucleotide variants.

sombrero.name: sombrero
sombrero.summary:
A next-generation conjugate gradient benchmark from computational
particle physics

sonlib.name: sonlib
sonlib.summary:
sonLib is a compact C/Python library for sequence analysis in
bioinformatics.

sopt.name: sopt
sopt.summary:
SOPT is an open-source C++ package available under the license below. It
performs Sparse OPTimisation using state-of-the-art convex optimisation
algorithms. It solves a variety of sparse regularisation problems,
including the Sparsity Averaging Reweighted Analysis (SARA) algorithm.

soqt.name: soqt
soqt.summary: Old Coin GUI binding for Qt, replaced by Quarter

sortmerna.name: sortmerna
sortmerna.summary:
SortMeRNA is a program tool for filtering, mapping and OTU-picking NGS
reads in metatranscriptomic and metagenomic data

sosflow.name: sosflow
sosflow.summary:
SOSflow provides a flexible, scalable, and programmable framework for
observation, introspection, feedback, and control of HPC applications.

source-highlight.name: source-highlight
source-highlight.summary:
This program, given a source file, produces a document with syntax
highlighting. It also provides a C++ highlight library (since version
3.0).

sourmash.name: sourmash
sourmash.summary:
Sourmash: Quickly search, compare, and analyze genomic and metagenomic
data sets with k-mer sketches.

sowing.name: sowing
sowing.summary:
Sowing generates Fortran interfaces and documentation for PETSc and
MPICH.

sox.name: sox
sox.summary: SoX, the Swiss Army knife of sound processing programs.

sp.name: sp
sp.summary:
The spectral transform library splib contains FORTRAN subprograms to be
used for a variety of spectral transform functions. This is part of the
NCEPLIBS project.

spaceranger.name: spaceranger
spaceranger.summary:
Space Ranger is a set of analysis pipelines that process Visium data
with brightfield and fluorescence microscope images. Space Ranger allows
users to map the whole transcriptome in formalin fixed paraffin embedded
(FFPE) and fresh frozen (FF) tissues. This package requires the user to
accept a license and to download the tarball manually. Once downloaded,
the file should be placed within a manual mirror or within the current
directory. For instructions on making a manual mirror, see
https://spack.readthedocs.io/en/latest/mirrors.html

spack.name: spack
spack.summary:
Spack is a multi-platform package manager that builds and installs
multiple versions and configurations of software. It works on Linux,
macOS, and many supercomputers. Spack is non-destructive: installing a
new version of a package does not break existing installations, so many
configurations of the same package can coexist.

spack-configs-dav-sdk.name: spack-configs-dav-sdk
spack-configs-dav-sdk.summary: Spack configs for the Data & Vis SDK.

spack-configs-tools-sdk.name: spack-configs-tools-sdk
spack-configs-tools-sdk.summary: Spack configs for the TOOLS SDK.

spades.name: spades
spades.summary:
SPAdes - St. Petersburg genome assembler - is intended for both standard
isolates and single-cell MDA bacteria assemblies.

span-lite.name: span-lite
span-lite.summary:
A single-file header-only version of a C++20-like span for C++98, C++11
and later

spark.name: spark
spark.summary:
Apache Spark is a fast and general engine for large-scale data
processing.

sparse.name: sparse
sparse.summary: An open source sparse linear equation solver.

sparsehash.name: sparsehash
sparsehash.summary: Sparse and dense hash-tables for C++ by Google

sparskit.name: sparskit
sparskit.summary:
SPARSKIT: A basic tool-kit for sparse matrix computations (Version 2).
Made by Yousef Saad, University of Minnesota.

sparta.name: sparta
sparta.summary:
small RNA-PARE Target Analyzer (sPARTA) is a tool which utilizes high-
throughput sequencing to profile genome-wide cleavage products.

spath.name: spath
spath.summary: Represent and manipulate file system paths

spatialdata.name: spatialdata
spatialdata.summary:
SpatialData provides an interface to Proj.4 for converting coordinates
Spatialdata is a C++ library for interpolating values for spatially
distributed data, converting coordinates among geographic projections
using Proj, nondimensionalization of quantities, specification of units
via Pyre (optional). This library is used in the finite-element code
PyLith (https://github.com/geodynamics/pylith). The primary focus is
specification of parameters that vary in space, such as values for
boundary conditions and parameters of constitutive models. This provides
a specification of these parameters independent of the discretization.

spatter.name: spatter
spatter.summary: A microbenchmark for timing Gather/Scatter kernels on CPUs and GPUs.

spdk.name: spdk
spdk.summary:
The Storage Performance Development Kit (SPDK) provides a set of tools
and libraries for writing high performance, scalable, user-mode storage
applications. It achieves high performance by moving all of the
necessary drivers into userspace and operating in a polled mode instead
of relying on interrupts, which avoids kernel context switches and
eliminates interrupt handling overhead.

spdlog.name: spdlog
spdlog.summary: Very fast, header only, C++ logging library

specfem3d-globe.name: specfem3d-globe
specfem3d-globe.summary:
Program specfem3D from SPECFEM3D_GLOBE is a 3-D spectral-element solver
for the Earth. It uses a mesh generated by program meshfem3D.

spectra.name: spectra
spectra.summary:
Spectra stands for Sparse Eigenvalue Computation Toolkit as a
Redesigned ARPACK. It is a C++ library for large scale eigenvalue
problems, built on top of Eigen, an open source linear algebra library.
Spectra is implemented as a header-only C++ library, whose only
dependency, Eigen, is also header-only. Hence Spectra can be easily
embedded in C++ projects that require calculating eigenvalues of large
matrices.

spectre.name: spectre
spectre.summary:
The SpECTRE numerical relativity code. SpECTRE is an open-source code
for multi-scale, multi-physics problems in astrophysics and
gravitational physics. In the future, we hope that it can be applied to
problems across discipline boundaries in fluid dynamics, geoscience,
plasma physics, nuclear physics, and engineering. It runs at petascale
and is designed for future exascale computers. SpECTRE is being
developed in support of our collaborative Simulating eXtreme Spacetimes
(SXS) research program into the multi-messenger astrophysics of neutron
star mergers, core-collapse supernovae, and gamma-ray bursts.

spectrum-mpi.name: spectrum-mpi
spectrum-mpi.summary: IBM MPI implementation from Spectrum MPI.

speex.name: speex
speex.summary:
Speex is an Open Source/Free Software patent-free audio compression
format designed for speech.

speexdsp.name: speexdsp
speexdsp.summary: SpeexDSP is a patent-free, Open Source/Free Software DSP library.

sperr.name: sperr
sperr.summary:
SPERR is a lossy scientific (floating-point) data compressor that can
perform either error-bounded or size-bounded data compression

spfft.name: spfft
spfft.summary: Sparse 3D FFT library with MPI, OpenMP, CUDA and ROCm support.

spglib.name: spglib
spglib.summary: C library for finding and handling crystal symmetries.

sph2pipe.name: sph2pipe
sph2pipe.summary:
Sph2pipe is a portable tool for converting SPHERE files to other
formats.

spherepack.name: spherepack
spherepack.summary: SPHEREPACK - A Package for Modeling Geophysical Processes

spindle.name: spindle
spindle.summary:
Spindle improves the library-loading performance of dynamically linked
HPC applications. Without Spindle large MPI jobs can overload on a
shared file system when loading dynamically linked libraries, causing
site-wide performance problems.

spiner.name: spiner
spiner.summary:
Spiner: Performance portable routines for generic, tabulated, multi-
dimensional data

spiral-package-fftx.name: spiral-package-fftx
spiral-package-fftx.summary:
This is the SPIRAL package for FFTX: FFTX is the exascale follow-on to
the FFTW open source discrete FFT package for executing the Fast Fourier
Transform as well as higher-level operations composed of linear
operations combined with DFT transforms.

spiral-package-hcol.name: spiral-package-hcol
spiral-package-hcol.summary:
This is the SPIRAL package for the Hybrid Control Operator Language
(HCOL).

spiral-package-jit.name: spiral-package-jit
spiral-package-jit.summary:
This is the SPIRAL package for Just-In-Time (JIT) or Real-Time
Compilation (RTC).

spiral-package-mpi.name: spiral-package-mpi
spiral-package-mpi.summary: This is the SPIRAL package for MPI.

spiral-package-simt.name: spiral-package-simt
spiral-package-simt.summary:
This is the SPIRAL package for SIMT: SIMT, single instruction multiple
threads, is used to generate code for GPUs and multi-threading
aplications.

spiral-software.name: spiral-software
spiral-software.summary:
SPIRAL is a program generation system for linear transforms and other
mathematical functions that produces very high performance code for a
wide spectrum of hardware platforms.

spla.name: spla
spla.summary:
Specialized Parallel Linear Algebra, providing distributed GEMM
functionality for specific matrix distributions with optional GPU
acceleration.

spm.name: spm
spm.summary:
Statistical Parametric Mapping refers to the construction and assessment
of spatially extended statistical processes used to test hypotheses
about functional imaging data. These ideas have been instantiated in
software that is called SPM.

spooles.name: spooles
spooles.summary:
SPOOLES is a library for solving sparse real and complex linear systems
of equations, written in C and using object-oriented design. It is a
build dependency of the CalculiX finite-element solver and its preCICE
adapter.

spot.name: spot
spot.summary:
Spot is a C++11 library for omega-automata manipulation and model
checking.

sprng.name: sprng
sprng.summary:
SPRNG: A Scalable Library For Pseudorandom Number Generation Sprng is a
distributed process-aware random number generator that avoids
correlations in random number sequences across processes.

spy.name: spy
spy.summary:
SPY - C++20 compile-time detection of compilers, operating systems,
architectures and SIMD extensions.

sqlcipher.name: sqlcipher
sqlcipher.summary:
SQLCipher is an SQLite extension that provides 256 bit AES encryption of
database files.

sqlite.name: sqlite
sqlite.summary:
SQLite is a C-language library that implements a small, fast, self-
contained, high-reliability, full-featured, SQL database engine.

sqlite-jdbc.name: sqlite-jdbc
sqlite-jdbc.summary:
SQLite JDBC, developed by Taro L. Saito, is a library for accessing and
creating SQLite database files in Java.

sqlitebrowser.name: sqlitebrowser
sqlitebrowser.summary:
DB Browser for SQLite (DB4S) is a high quality, visual, open source tool
to create, design, and edit database files compatible with SQLite.

sqoop.name: sqoop
sqoop.summary:
Apache Sqoop is a tool designed for efficiently transferring bulk data
between Apache Hadoop and structured datastores such as relational
databases.

squashfs-mount.name: squashfs-mount
squashfs-mount.summary:
Allows non-root users to mount squashfs files without the overhead of
squashfuse.

squashfuse.name: squashfuse
squashfuse.summary: squashfuse - Mount SquashFS archives using FUSE

squid.name: squid
squid.summary: C function library for sequence analysis.

sra-tools.name: sra-tools
sra-tools.summary:
The SRA Toolkit and SDK from NCBI is a collection of tools and libraries
for using data in the INSDC Sequence Read Archives.

sratoolkit.name: sratoolkit
sratoolkit.summary:
The NCBI SRA Toolkit enables reading ("dumping") of sequencing files
from the SRA database and writing ("loading") files into the .sra
format.

srcml.name: srcml
srcml.summary:
srcML is an XML format for source code. The XML markup identifies
elements of the abstract syntax of the source-code language. The toolkit
includes parsing supports conversion of C, C++, C#, and Java both to and
from the srcML format. The format allows leveraging XML tools to support
the various tasks of source code exploration, analysis, and
manipulation.

srcml-identifier-getter-tool.name: srcml-identifier-getter-tool
srcml-identifier-getter-tool.summary:
SCANL's srcml_identifier_getter_tool. reads a srcML archive and outputs
all identifiers in that archive through standard out.

srilm.name: srilm
srilm.summary:
SRILM (SRI Language Modeling Toolkit) is a toolkit for building and
applying statistical language models (LMs), primarily for use in speech
recognition, statistical tagging and segmentation, and machine
translation.

srm-ifce.name: srm-ifce
srm-ifce.summary: Client side implementation of the SRMv2 specification.

sse2neon.name: sse2neon
sse2neon.summary:
A C/C++ header file that converts Intel SSE intrinsics to Arm/Aarch64
NEON intrinsics.

sshfs.name: sshfs
sshfs.summary: SSHFS allows you to mount a remote filesystem using SFTP.

sshpass.name: sshpass
sshpass.summary:
Sshpass is a tool for non-interactivly performing password
authentication with SSH's so called "interactive keyboard password
authentication". Most user should use SSH's more secure public key
authentiaction instead.

ssht.name: ssht
ssht.summary:
ssht: Spin spherical harmonic transforms. The SSHT code provides
functionality to perform fast and exact spin spherical harmonic
transforms based on the sampling theorem on the sphere derived in our
paper: A novel sampling theorem on the sphere
<http://dx.doi.org/10.1109/TSP.2011.2166394>.

ssmtp.name: ssmtp
ssmtp.summary:
A program that replaces sendmail on workstations that should send their
mail via the departmental mailhub from which they pick up their mail.

sspace-longread.name: sspace-longread
sspace-longread.summary:
SSPACE-LongRead is a stand-alone program for scaffolding pre-assembled
contigs using long reads Note: A manual download is required for SSPACE-
LongRead. Spack will search your current directory for the download
file. Alternatively, add this file to a mirror so that Spack can find
it. For instructions on how to set up a mirror, see
https://spack.readthedocs.io/en/latest/mirrors.html

sspace-standard.name: sspace-standard
sspace-standard.summary:
SSPACE standard is a stand-alone program for scaffolding pre-assembled
contigs using NGS paired-read data Note: A manual download is required
for SSPACE-Standard. Spack will search your current directory for the
download file. Alternatively, add this file to a mirror so that Spack
can find it. For instructions on how to set up a mirror, see
https://spack.readthedocs.io/en/latest/mirrors.html

sst-core.name: sst-core
sst-core.summary:
The Structural Simulation Toolkit (SST) core provides a parallel
discrete event simulation (PDES) framework for performing architecture
simulations of existing and proposed HPC systems

sst-dumpi.name: sst-dumpi
sst-dumpi.summary:
The DUMPI package provides libraries to collect and read traces of MPI
applications. Traces are created by linking an application with a
library that uses the PMPI interface to intercept MPI calls. DUMPI
records signatures of all MPI-1 and MPI-2 subroutine calls, return
values, request information, and PAPI counters.

sst-elements.name: sst-elements
sst-elements.summary:
SST Elements implements a range of components for performing
architecture simulation from node-level to system-level using the SST
discrete event core.

sst-macro.name: sst-macro
sst-macro.summary:
The Structural Simulation Toolkit Macroscale Element Library simulates
large-scale parallel computer architectures for the coarse-grained study
of distributed-memory applications. The simulator is driven from either
a trace file or skeleton application. SST/macro's modular architecture
can be extended with additional network models, trace file formats,
software services, and processor models.

sst-transports.name: sst-transports
sst-transports.summary: Provides transports like uGNI and verbs that run in the simulator

stacks.name: stacks
stacks.summary:
Stacks is a software pipeline for building loci from short-read
sequences, such as those generated on the Illumina platform.

staden-io-lib.name: staden-io-lib
staden-io-lib.summary:
Io_lib is a library for reading/writing various bioinformatics file
formats.

star.name: star
star.summary: STAR is an ultrafast universal RNA-seq aligner.

starlight.name: starlight
starlight.summary:
STARlight is a Monte Carlo that simulates two-photon and photon-Pomeron
interactions between relativistic nuclei and protons.

starpu.name: starpu
starpu.summary:
StarPU runtime system StarPU is a runtime support for scheduling
applications written as task graphs on heterogeneous multi-core
architectures. Tasks may define several implementations, for different
architectures (e.g one implementation for CPUs, and one implementation
for CUDA). StarPU takes care of scheduling and executing those tasks as
efficiently as possible over the entire machine. It also provides a
high-level data management library which enforces memory coherency over
the differents processing units of the machine, and over a cluster when
using distributed computing. Various data structures are supported
mainline (vectors, dense matrices, CSR/BCSR/COO sparse matrices, ...),
but application-specific data structures can also be supported.

starship.name: starship
starship.summary:
The minimal, blazing-fast, and infinitely customizable prompt for any
shell!

startup-notification.name: startup-notification
startup-notification.summary:
startup-notification contains a reference implementation of the
freedesktop startup notification protocol.

stat.name: stat
stat.summary: Library to create, manipulate, and export graphs Graphlib.

stata.name: stata
stata.summary:
STATA is a general-purpose statistical software package developed by
StataCorp.

stdexec.name: stdexec
stdexec.summary: The proposed C++ framework for asynchronous and parallel programming.

stinger.name: stinger
stinger.summary:
The STINGER in-memory graph store and dynamic graph analysis platform.
Millions to billions of vertices and edges at thousands to millions of
updates per second.

storm.name: storm
storm.summary:
Storm is a distributed realtime computation system. Similar to how
Hadoop provides a set of general primitives for doing batch processing,
Storm provides a set of general primitives for doing realtime
computation.

stow.name: stow
stow.summary:
GNU Stow: a symlink farm manager GNU Stow is a symlink farm manager
which takes distinct packages of software and/or data located in
separate directories on the filesystem, and makes them appear to be
installed in the same place.

strace.name: strace
strace.summary:
Strace is a diagnostic, debugging and instructional userspace utility
for Linux. It is used to monitor and tamper with interactions between
processes and the Linux kernel, which include system calls, signal
deliveries, and changes of process state.

stream.name: stream
stream.summary:
The STREAM benchmark is a simple synthetic benchmark program that
measures sustainable memory bandwidth (in MB/s) and the corresponding
computation rate for simple vector kernels.

stress.name: stress
stress.summary:
stress is a deliberately simple workload generator for POSIX systems. It
imposes a configurable amount of CPU, memory, I/O, and disk stress on
the system. It is written in C, and is free software licensed under the
GPLv2.

stress-ng.name: stress-ng
stress-ng.summary:
stress-ng will stress test a computer system in various selectable ways.
It was designed to exercise various physical subsystems of a computer as
well as the various operating system kernel interfaces.

stressapptest.name: stressapptest
stressapptest.summary:
Stressful Application Test (or stressapptest, its unix name) is a
memory interface test. It tries to maximize randomized traffic to memory
from processor and I/O, with the intent of creating a realistic high
load situation in order to test the existing hardware devices in a
computer. It has been used at Google for some time and now it is
available under the apache 2.0 license.

string-view-lite.name: string-view-lite
string-view-lite.summary:
A single-file header-only version of a C++17-like string_view for
C++98, C++11 and later

stringtie.name: stringtie
stringtie.summary:
StringTie is a fast and highly efficient assembler of RNA-Seq alignments
into potential transcripts.

stripack.name: stripack
stripack.summary:
STRIPACK: Delaunay Triangulation rewritten in Fortran 90 by John
Burkardt at
https://people.sc.fsu.edu/~jburkardt/f_src/stripack/stripack.html The
original Fortran 77 package STRIPACK is available from netlib as
algorithm number 772 at https://www.netlib.org/toms/772.gz Dr. Renka's
articles were published in the ACM Transactions on Mathematical
Software, Vol. 23, No 3, September 1997.
https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/275323.275329

structure.name: structure
structure.summary:
Structure is a free software package for using multi-locus genotype data
to investigate population structure.

strumpack.name: strumpack
strumpack.summary:
STRUMPACK -- STRUctured Matrix PACKage - provides linear solvers for
sparse matrices and for dense rank-structured matrices, i.e., matrices
that exhibit some kind of low-rank property. It provides a distributed
memory fully algebraic sparse solver and preconditioner. The
preconditioner is mostly aimed at large sparse linear systems which
result from the discretization of a partial differential equation, but
is not limited to any particular type of problem. STRUMPACK also
provides preconditioned GMRES and BiCGStab iterative solvers.

su2.name: su2
su2.summary:
SU2 is a suite of open-source software tools written in C++ for the
numerical solution of partial differential equations (PDE) and
performing PDE constrained optimization.

sublime-text.name: sublime-text
sublime-text.summary: Sublime Text is a sophisticated text editor for code, markup and prose.

subread.name: subread
subread.summary:
The Subread software package is a tool kit for processing next-gen
sequencing data.

licenses: Apache-2.0 AND BSD-3-Clause AND BSD-2-Clause AND MIT
subversion.name: subversion
subversion.summary: Apache Subversion - an open source version control system.

suite-sparse.name: suite-sparse
suite-sparse.summary: SuiteSparse is a suite of sparse matrix algorithms

sumaclust.name: sumaclust
sumaclust.summary:
Sumaclust aims to cluster sequences in a way that is fast and exact at
the same time.

sumo.name: sumo
sumo.summary:
Eclipse SUMO is an open source, highly portable, microscopic and
continuous road traffic simulation package designed to handle large road
networks. It allows for intermodal simulation including pedestrians and
comes with a large set of tools for scenario creation.

sundials.name: sundials
sundials.summary:
SUNDIALS (SUite of Nonlinear and DIfferential/ALgebraic equation
Solvers)

suntans.name: suntans
suntans.summary:
The Stanford unstructured-grid, nonhydrostatic, parallel coastal ocean
model.

superchic.name: superchic
superchic.summary:
SuperChic is a Fortran based Monte Carlo event generator for exclusive
and photon-initiated production in proton and heavy ion collisions. A
range of Standard Model final states are implemented, in most cases with
spin correlations where relevant, and a fully differential treatment of
the soft survival factor is given. Arbitrary user-defined histograms and
cuts may be made, as well as unweighted events in the HEPEVT, HEPMC and
LHE formats.

superlu.name: superlu
superlu.summary:
SuperLU is a general purpose library for the direct solution of large,
sparse, nonsymmetric systems of linear equations on high performance
machines. SuperLU is designed for sequential machines.

superlu-dist.name: superlu-dist
superlu-dist.summary:
A general purpose library for the direct solution of large, sparse,
nonsymmetric systems of linear equations on high performance machines.

superlu-mt.name: superlu-mt
superlu-mt.summary:
SuperLU is a general purpose library for the direct solution of large,
sparse, nonsymmetric systems of linear equations on high performance
machines. SuperLU_MT is designed for shared memory parallel machines.

supermagic.name: supermagic
supermagic.summary: Supermagic is a very simple MPI sanity code. Nothing more, nothing less.

surfer.name: surfer
surfer.summary:
A waveform viewer with a focus on a snappy usable interface, and
extensibility.

survey.name: survey
survey.summary:
Survey is a high level performance tool product from Trenza, Inc. The
survey collector/analytics framework is a new generation, high level,
lightweight multiplatform Linux tool set that targets metric collection
for high level performance analysis of applications running on both
single node and on large scale platforms, including the Cray platforms.
The collector is designed to work on sequential, MPI, OpenMP, and hybrid
codes and directly leverages several interfaces available for tools
inside current MPI implementations including: MPICH, MVAPICH, MPT, and
OpenMPI. It also supports multiple architectures and has been tested on
machines based on Intel, AMD, ARM, and IBM P8/9 processors and
integrated AMD and NVIDIA GPUs. Survey is a licensed product with the
source not openly available. To access the survey source and build with
spack please contact: Trenza Inc. via: dmont@trenzasynergy.com or
jeg@trenzasynergy.com

sw4.name: sw4
sw4.summary: SW4 implements substantial capabilities for 3-D seismic modeling.

sw4lite.name: sw4lite
sw4lite.summary:
Sw4lite is a bare bone version of SW4 intended for testing performance
optimizations in a few important numerical kernels of SW4.

swan.name: swan
swan.summary:
SWAN is a third-generation wave model, developed at Delft University of
Technology, that computes random, short-crested wind-generated waves in
coastal regions and inland waters. For more information about SWAN, see
a short overview of model features. This list reflects on the scientific
relevance of the development of SWAN.

swap-assembler.name: swap-assembler
swap-assembler.summary: A scalable and fully parallelized genome assembler.

swarm.name: swarm
swarm.summary: A robust and fast clustering method for amplicon-based studies.

swfft.name: swfft
swfft.summary:
A stand-alone version of HACC's distributed-memory, pencil-decomposed,
parallel 3D FFT.

swftools.name: swftools
swftools.summary:
SWFTools is a collection of utilities for working with Adobe Flash files
(SWF files). The tool collection includes programs for reading SWF
files, combining them, and creating them from other content (like
images, sound files, videos or sourcecode). SWFTools is released under
the GPL.

swiftsim.name: swiftsim
swiftsim.summary:
SPH With Inter-dependent Fine-grained Tasking (SWIFT) provides
astrophysicists with a state of the art framework to perform particle
based simulations.

swig.name: swig
swig.summary:
SWIG is an interface compiler that connects programs written in C and
C++ with scripting languages such as Perl, Python, Ruby, and Tcl. It
works by taking the declarations found in C/C++ header files and using
them to generate the wrapper code that scripting languages need to
access the underlying C/C++ code. In addition, SWIG provides a variety
of customization features that let you tailor the wrapping process to
suit your application.

swipl.name: swipl
swipl.summary:
SWI-Prolog is a versatile implementation of the Prolog language.
Although SWI-Prolog gained its popularity primarily in education, its
development is mostly driven by the needs for application development.
This is facilitated by a rich interface to other IT components by
supporting many document types and (network) protocols as well as a
comprehensive low-level interface to C that is the basis for high-level
interfaces to C++, Java (bundled), C#, Python, etc (externally
available). Data type extensions such as dicts and strings as well as
full support for Unicode and unbounded integers simplify smooth exchange
of data with other components.

sycl.name: hipsycl
sycl.summary:
hipSYCL is an implementation of the SYCL standard programming model over
NVIDIA CUDA/AMD HIP

syclomatic.name: syclomatic
syclomatic.summary:
SYCLomatic is a tool to assist developers in migrating existing CUDA
code to SYCL C++ heterogeneous programming. The main binary is ``c2s``
(also available as ``dpct``).

symengine.name: symengine
symengine.summary: SymEngine is a fast symbolic manipulation library, written in C++.

sympack.name: sympack
sympack.summary:
symPACK is a sparse symmetric matrix direct linear solver, with optional
support for CUDA devices

sympol.name: sympol
sympol.summary: SymPol is a C++ tool to work with symmetric polyhedra

sys-sage.name: sys-sage
sys-sage.summary:
A library for capturing hardware topology and attributes of compute
systems.

sysbench.name: sysbench
sysbench.summary: Scriptable database and system performance benchmark.

syscalc.name: syscalc
syscalc.summary: A tool to derive theoretical systematic uncertainties

sysfsutils.name: sysfsutils
sysfsutils.summary:
This package's purpose is to provide a set of utilities for interfacing
with sysfs, a virtual filesystem in Linux kernel versions 2.5+ that
provides a tree of system devices. While a filesystem is a very useful
interface, we've decided to provide a stable programming interface that
will hopefully make it easier for applications to query system devices
and their attributes.

sysget.name: sysget
sysget.summary:
sysget is a bridge that lets you use one syntax to every package manager
on every unix-based operating system.

sysstat.name: sysstat
sysstat.summary:
The sysstat package contains various utilities, common to many
commercial Unixes, to monitor system performance and usage activity
Sysstat also contains tools you can schedule via cron or systemd to
collect and historize performance and activity data.

systemc.name: systemc
systemc.summary:
SystemC: System level modeling, design exploration, performance
modeling, and more.

systemd.name: systemd
systemd.summary:
systemd is a suite of basic building blocks for a Linux system. It
provides a system and service manager that runs as PID 1 and starts the
rest of the system.

systemtap.name: systemtap
systemtap.summary:
SystemTap provides free software (GPL) infrastructure to simplify the
gathering of information about the running Linux system. This assists
diagnosis of a performance or functional problem. SystemTap eliminates
the need for the developer to go through the tedious and disruptive
instrument, recompile, install, and reboot sequence that may be
otherwise required to collect data.

sz.name: sz
sz.summary: Error-bounded Lossy Compressor for HPC Data

sz3.name: sz3
sz3.summary: SZ3 is the next generation of the SZ compressor framework

szauto.name: szauto
szauto.summary:
SZauto: SZ C++ Version that Supports Second-Order Prediction and
Parameter Optimization

szip.name: libszip
szip.summary:
Szip is an implementation of the extended-Rice lossless compression
algorithm. It provides lossless compression of scientific data, and is
provided with HDF software products.

szx.name: szx
szx.summary: An ultra fast error bounded compressor for scientific datasets

t8code.name: t8code
t8code.summary:
t8code is a C/C++ library to manage parallel adaptive meshes with
various element types. t8code uses a collection (a forest) of multiple
connected adaptive space-trees in parallel and scales to at least one
million MPI ranks and over one Trillion mesh elements.

tabix.name: tabix
tabix.summary: Generic indexer for TAB-delimited genome position files

tajo.name: tajo
tajo.summary:
Tajo is a relational and distributed data warehouse system for Hadoop
Tajo is designed for low-latency and scalable ad-hoc queries, online
aggregation and ETL on large-data sets by leveraging advanced database
techniques. It supports SQL standards. It has its own query engine which
allows direct control of distributed execution and data flow. As a
result, Tajo has a variety of query evaluation strategies and more
optimization opportunities. In addition, Tajo will have a native
columnar execution and and its optimizer.

talass.name: talass
talass.summary:
TALASS: Topological Analysis of Large-Scale Simulations This package
compiles the talass tool chain thar implements various topological
algorithms to analyze large scale data. The package is organized
hierarchical FileFormat < Statistics < StreamingTopology and any of the
subsets can be build stand- alone.

talloc.name: talloc
talloc.summary:
Talloc provides a hierarchical, reference counted memory pool system
with destructors. It is the core memory allocator used in Samba.

talosctl.name: talosctl
talosctl.summary: A CLI for out-of-band management of Kubernetes nodes created by Talos.

tamaas.name: tamaas
tamaas.summary:
Tamaas is a C++ library with a Python interface that efficiently solves
contact mechanics problems with periodic rough surfaces, plasticity,
adhesion and friction.

tandem.name: tandem
tandem.summary:
Tandem is a scientific software for SEAS modelling and for solving
Poisson and linear elasticity problems. It implements the Symmetric
Interior Penalty Galerkin (SIPG) method using unstructured simplicial
meshes (triangle meshes in 2D, tetrahedral meshes in 3D).

tangram.name: tangram
tangram.summary:
Tangram is an material interface reconstruction package used in
multimaterial ALE codes and multi-material remapping
(https://github.com/laristra/portage)

tantan.name: tantan
tantan.summary:
tantan is a tool to mask simple regions (low complexity and short-period
tandem repeats) in DNA, RNA, and protein sequences.

tar.name: tar
tar.summary:
GNU Tar provides the ability to create tar archives, as well as various
other kinds of manipulation.

targetp.name: targetp
targetp.summary:
TargetP predicts the subcellular location of eukaryotic protein
sequences. Note: A manual download is required for TargetP. Spack will
search your current directory for the download file. Alternatively, add
this file to a mirror so that Spack can find it. For instructions on how
to set up a mirror, see
https://spack.readthedocs.io/en/latest/mirrors.html

task.name: task
task.summary: Feature-rich console based todo list manager

taskflow.name: taskflow
taskflow.summary: Taskflow helps you quickly write parallel tasks programs in modern C++.

tasmanian.name: tasmanian
tasmanian.summary:
The Toolkit for Adaptive Stochastic Modeling and Non-Intrusive
ApproximatioN is a robust library for high dimensional integration and
interpolation as well as parameter calibration.

tassel.name: tassel
tassel.summary:
TASSEL is a software package to evaluate traits associations,
evolutionary patterns, and linkage disequilibrium.

tau.name: tau
tau.summary:
A portable profiling and tracing toolkit for performance analysis of
parallel programs written in Fortran, C, C++, UPC, Java, Python.

tauola.name: tauola
tauola.summary: Tauola is a event generator for tau decays.

tb-lmto.name: tb-lmto
tb-lmto.summary:
The STUTTGART TB-LMTO program. The linear muffin-tin orbital (LMTO)
method has been described in numerous publications. Use of this software
is subject to the license at https://www2.fkf.mpg.de/andersen/LMTODOC/no
de180.html#SECTION000130000000000000000

tbb.name: intel-tbb
tbb.summary:
Widely used C++ template library for task parallelism. Intel Threading
Building Blocks (Intel TBB) lets you easily write parallel C++ programs
that take full advantage of multicore performance, that are portable and
composable, and that have future-proof scalability.

tbl2asn.name: tbl2asn
tbl2asn.summary:
Tbl2asn is a command-line program that automates the creation of
sequence records for submission to GenBank.

tcl.name: tcl
tcl.summary:
Tcl (Tool Command Language) is a very powerful but easy to learn dynamic
programming language, suitable for a very wide range of uses, including
web and desktop applications, networking, administration, testing and
many more. Open source and business-friendly, Tcl is a mature yet
evolving language that is truly cross platform, easily deployed and
highly extensible.

tcl-itcl.name: tcl-itcl
tcl-itcl.summary:
[incr Tcl] is the most widely used O-O system for Tcl. The name is a
play on C++, and [incr Tcl] provides a similar object model, including
multiple inheritence and public and private classes and variables.

tcl-tcllib.name: tcl-tcllib
tcl-tcllib.summary:
Tcllib is a collection of utility modules for Tcl. These modules provide
a wide variety of functionality, from implementations of standard data
structures to implementations of common networking protocols. The intent
is to collect commonly used function into a single library, which users
can rely on to be available and stable.

tcl-tclxml.name: tcl-tclxml
tcl-tclxml.summary:
TclXML is an API for parsing XML documents using the Tcl scripting
language. It is also a package including a DOM implementation (TclDOM)
and XSL Transformations (TclXSLT). These allow Tcl scripts to read,
manipulate and write XML documents.

tcl-togl.name: tcl-togl
tcl-togl.summary:
Tcl-Togl provides a platform independent Tcl/Tk widget for using OpenGL
rendering contexts

tcoffee.name: tcoffee
tcoffee.summary: T-Coffee is a multiple sequence alignment program.

tcpdump.name: tcpdump
tcpdump.summary:
Tcpdump prints out a description of the contents of packets on a network
interface that match the Boolean expression; the description is preceded
by a time stamp, printed, by default, as hours, minutes, seconds, and
fractions of a second since midnight.

tcptrace.name: tcptrace
tcptrace.summary:
tcptrace is a tool written by Shawn Ostermann at Ohio University for
analysis of TCP dump files. It can take as input the files produced by
several popular packet-capture programs, including tcpdump, snoop,
etherpeek, HP Net Metrix, and WinDump.

tcsh.name: tcsh
tcsh.summary:
Tcsh is an enhanced but completely compatible version of csh, the C
shell. Tcsh is a command language interpreter which can be used both as
an interactive login shell and as a shell script command processor. Tcsh
includes a command line editor, programmable word completion, spelling
correction, a history mechanism, job control and a C language like
syntax.

tdengine.name: tdengine
tdengine.summary:
An open-source big data platform designed and optimized for the Internet
of Things (IoT).

tdls.name: tdls
tdls.summary:
TDLS (Tiny Device-callable Linear Solvers) is a header-only C++20
library of direct solvers for small dense linear systems, developed by
CEA. The solvers are callable from host code as well as inside CUDA,
HIP, SYCL, Kokkos, stdpar or OpenMP kernels, and are designed to be
embedded in TFEL/MFront.

tealeaf.name: tealeaf
tealeaf.summary:
Proxy Application. TeaLeaf is a mini-app that solves the linear heat
conduction equation on a spatially decomposed regularly grid using a 5
point stencil with implicit solvers.

tecio.name: tecio
tecio.summary:
The TecIO library allows third-party applications to read and write
Tecplot file format.

teckit.name: teckit
teckit.summary:
TECkit is a low-level toolkit intended to be used by applications for
conversions between text encodings. For example, it can be used when
importing legacy text into a Unicode-based application. The primary
component of TECkit is a library: the TECkit engine. The engine relies
on mapping tables in a specific, documented binary format. The TECkit
compiler creates these tables from plain-text, human-readable
descriptions.

tecplot.name: tecplot
tecplot.summary:
Tecplot 360 is a Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) and numerical
simulation software package used in post-processing simulation results.
It is also used in chemistry applications to visualize molecule
structure by post-processing charge density data.

telegraf.name: telegraf
telegraf.summary:
Telegraf is an agent for collecting, processing, aggregating, and
writing metrics.

telocal.name: telocal
telocal.summary:
A package for quantifying transposable elements at a locus level for
RNAseq datasets

tempestextremes.name: tempestextremes
tempestextremes.summary:
TempestExtremes is a growing collection of detection and
characterization algorithms for large climate datasets, leveraging C++
for rapid throughput and a command line interface that maximizes
flexibility of each kernel. The tracking kernels in this package have
been already used for tracking and characterizing tropical cyclones
(TCs), extratropical cyclones (ETCs), monsoonal depressions, atmospheric
blocks, atmospheric rivers, and mesoscale convective systems (MCSs). By
considering multiple extremes within the same framework, we can study
the joint characteristics of extremes while minimizing the total data
burden.

tempestremap.name: tempestremap
tempestremap.summary:
TempestRemap is a conservative, consistent and monotone remapping
package for arbitrary grid geometry with support for finite volumes and
finite elements. There is still quite a bit of work to be done, but any
feedback is appreciated on the software in its current form

templight.name: templight
templight.summary:
Templight is a Clang-based tool to profile the time and memory
consumption of template instantiations and to perform interactive
debugging sessions to gain introspection into the template instantiation
process.

templight-tools.name: templight-tools
templight-tools.summary: Supporting tools for the Templight Profiler

tempo.name: tempo
tempo.summary: Tempo is a program for pulsar timing data analysis.

tengine.name: tengine
tengine.summary: A distribution of Nginx with some advanced features.

tensorflow-serving-client.name: tensorflow-serving-client
tensorflow-serving-client.summary:
A prebuilt tensorflow serving client from the tensorflow serving proto
files

tensorpipe.name: tensorpipe
tensorpipe.summary:
A tensor-aware point-to-point communication primitive for machine
learning.

termcap.name: termcap
termcap.summary:
This is the GNU termcap library, a library of C functions that enable
programs to send control strings to terminals in a way independent of
the terminal type.

terminalimageviewer.name: terminalimageviewer
terminalimageviewer.summary:
Small C++ program to display images in a (modern) terminal using RGB
ANSI codes and unicode block graphic characters.

test-drive.name: test-drive
test-drive.summary: Simple testing framework for Fortran packages

tests-sos.name: tests-sos
tests-sos.summary: Sandia OpenSHMEM unit tests and performance testing suite.

testu01.name: testu01
testu01.summary:
TestU01 is a software library, implemented in the ANSI C language, and
offering a collection of utilities for the empirical statistical testing
of uniform random number generators.

tetgen.name: tetgen
tetgen.summary:
TetGen is a program and library that can be used to generate tetrahedral
meshes for given 3D polyhedral domains. TetGen generates exact
constrained Delaunay tetrahedralizations, boundary conforming Delaunay
meshes, and Voronoi paritions.

tethex.name: tethex
tethex.summary:
Tethex is designed to convert triangular (in 2D) or tetrahedral (in 3D)
Gmsh's mesh to quadrilateral or hexahedral one respectively. These
meshes can be used in software packages working with hexahedrals only -
for example, deal.II.

tetranscripts.name: tetranscripts
tetranscripts.summary:
TEtranscripts: Tools for estimating differential enrichment of
Transposable Elements and other highly repetitive regions.

texi2html.name: texi2html
texi2html.summary: A highly customizable texinfo to HTML and other formats translator.

texinfo.name: texinfo
texinfo.summary:
Texinfo is the official documentation format of the GNU project. It was
invented by Richard Stallman and Bob Chassell many years ago, loosely
based on Brian Reid's Scribe and other formatting languages of the time.
It is used by many non-GNU projects as well.

texlive.name: texlive
texlive.summary:
TeX Live is an easy (we hope) way to get up and running with the TeX
document production system. It provides a comprehensive TeX system with
binaries for most flavors of Unix, including GNU/Linux, macOS, and also
Windows. It includes all the major TeX-related programs, macro packages,
and fonts that are free software, including support for many languages
around the world.

texstudio.name: texstudio
texstudio.summary:
TeXstudio is a fully featured LaTeX editor, whose goal is to make
writing LaTeX documents as easy and comfortable as possible.

textparser.name: textparser
textparser.summary:
Text Parser library allows us to describe and to parse JSON like simple
parameter structure.

tfel.name: tfel
tfel.summary:
The TFEL project is a collaborative development of CEA (French
Alternative Energies and Atomic Energy Commission) and EDF (Electricite
de France). It mostly contains the MFront code generator which
translates a set of closely related domain specific languages into plain
C++ on top of the TFEL libraries. MFront handles material properties,
mechanical behaviours and simple point-wise models. Interfaces are
provided for several finite element solvers, such as: Abaqus/Standard,
Abaqus/Explicit, Ansys APDL, Cast3M, Europlexus, Code_Aster, CalculiX
and a few others. MFront comes with an handy easy-to-use tool called
MTest that can test the local behaviour of a material, by imposing
independent constraints on each component of the strain or the stress.

theia-ide.name: theia-ide
theia-ide.summary:
A modern and open IDE for cloud and desktop. The Theia IDE is based on
the Theia platform.

thepeg.name: thepeg
thepeg.summary: Toolkit for High Energy Physics Event Generation

thermo4pfm.name: thermo4pfm
thermo4pfm.summary: Library to evaluate alloy compositions in Phase-Field models

thesis.name: thesis
thesis.summary:
3dThesis is a heat transfer code utilizing a nondimensionalized semi-
analytic solution to moving heat sources with a 3D Gaussian power
density

thornado-mini.name: thornado-mini
thornado-mini.summary:
Code to solve the equation of radiative transfer in the multi-group two-
moment approximation

thrift.name: thrift
thrift.summary:
Software framework for scalable cross-language services development.
Thrift combines a software stack with a code generation engine to build
services that work efficiently and seamlessly between C++, Java, Python,
PHP, Ruby, Erlang, Perl, Haskell, C#, Cocoa, JavaScript, Node.js,
Smalltalk, OCaml and Delphi and other languages.

thrust.name: thrust
thrust.summary:
Thrust is a parallel algorithms library which resembles the C++ Standard
Template Library (STL).

thunar-volman.name: thunar-volman
thunar-volman.summary:
Thunar extension which enables automatic management of removable drives
and media.

tidy-html5.name: tidy-html5
tidy-html5.summary:
Tidy is a console application for Mac OS X, Linux, Windows, UNIX, and
more. It corrects and cleans up HTML and XML documents by fixing markup
errors and upgrading legacy code to modern standards.

tiled-mm.name: tiled-mm
tiled-mm.summary:
Matrix multiplication on GPUs for matrices stored on a CPU. Similar to
cublasXt, but ported to both NVIDIA and AMD GPUs.

time.name: time
time.summary:
The time command runs another program, then displays information about
the resources used by that program.

timedatex.name: timedatex
timedatex.summary:
timedatex is a D-Bus service that implements the
org.freedesktop.timedate1 interface. It can be used to read and set the
system clock, the real-time clock (RTC), the system timezone, get a list
of valid timezones, and enable or disable an NTP client installed on the
system. It is a replacement for the systemd-timedated service.

timemory.name: timemory
timemory.summary:
Modular profiling toolkit and suite of libraries and tools for
C/C++/Fortran/CUDA/Python

timew.name: timew
timew.summary:
Timewarrior is Free and Open Source Software that tracks time from the
command line.

timg.name: timg
timg.summary: Timg: a terminal image and video viewer.

tini.name: tini
tini.summary: A tiny but valid `init` for containers

tinker.name: tinker
tinker.summary:
The Tinker molecular modeling software is a complete and general package
for molecular mechanics and dynamics, with some special features for
biopolymers.

tiny-tensor-compiler.name: tiny-tensor-compiler
tiny-tensor-compiler.summary:
A compiler for tensor computations on GPUs and other devices, supporting
the OpenCL, Level Zero, and SYCL runtime.

tinygltf.name: tinygltf
tinygltf.summary: Header only C++11 tiny glTF 2.0 library.

tinyobjloader.name: tinyobjloader
tinyobjloader.summary: Tiny but powerful single file wavefront obj loader.

tinyxml.name: tinyxml
tinyxml.summary: Simple, small, efficient, C++ XML parser

tinyxml2.name: tinyxml2
tinyxml2.summary: Simple, small, efficient, C++ XML parser

tippecanoe.name: tippecanoe
tippecanoe.summary: Build vector tilesets from large collections of GeoJSON features.

tiptop.name: tiptop
tiptop.summary: Tiptop is a performance monitoring tool for Linux.

tiramisu.name: tiramisu
tiramisu.summary:
Tiramisu is a polyhedral compiler for dense and sparse deep learning and
data parallel algorithms.It provides a simple C++ API for expressing
algorithms and how these algorithms should be optimized by the compiler.

tix.name: tix
tix.summary:
Tix, the Tk Interface eXtension, is a powerful set of user interface
components that expands the capabilities of your Tcl/Tk and Python
applications. Using Tix together with Tk will greatly enhance the
appearance and functionality of your application.

tixi.name: tixi
tixi.summary:
TiXI is a fast and simple XML interface library and could be used from
applications written in C, C++, Fortran, JAVA and Python.

tk.name: tk
tk.summary:
Tk is a graphical user interface toolkit that takes developing desktop
applications to a higher level than conventional approaches. Tk is the
standard GUI not only for Tcl, but for many other dynamic languages, and
can produce rich, native applications that run unchanged across Windows,
Mac OS X, Linux and more.

tkrzw.name: tkrzw
tkrzw.summary:
Tkrzw is a C++ library implementing database managers with various
algorithms.

tldd.name: tldd
tldd.summary: A program similar to ldd(1) but showing the output as a tree.

tmalign.name: tmalign
tmalign.summary:
TM-align is an algorithm for sequence-order independent protein
structure comparisons.

tmhmm.name: tmhmm
tmhmm.summary:
Transmembrane helices in proteins Note: A manual download is required
for TMHMM. Spack will search your current directory for the download
file. Alternatively, add this file to a mirror so that Spack can find
it. For instructions on how to set up a mirror, see
https://spack.readthedocs.io/en/latest/mirrors.html

tmscore.name: tmscore
tmscore.summary:
TM-score is a metric for assessing the topological similarity of protein
structures.

tmux.name: tmux
tmux.summary:
Tmux is a terminal multiplexer. What is a terminal multiplexer? It lets
you switch easily between several programs in one terminal, detach them
(they keep running in the background) and reattach them to a different
terminal. And do a lot more.

tnftp.name: tnftp
tnftp.summary:
Tnftp is an FTP client. It is the default FTP client included with many
BSD operating systems and Darwin

tofu-ls.name: tofu-ls
tofu-ls.summary:
The official OpenTofu language server, provides IDE features to any LSP-
compatible editor

tomcat.name: tomcat
tomcat.summary:
The Apache Tomcat software is an open source implementation of the Java
Servlet, JavaServer Pages, Java Expression Language and Java WebSocket
technologies.

toml-f.name: toml-f
toml-f.summary:
TOML parser implementation for data serialization and deserialization in
Fortran

toml11.name: toml11
toml11.summary:
toml11 is a C++11 (or later) header-only toml parser/encoder depending
only on C++ standard library.

tomlplusplus.name: tomlplusplus
tomlplusplus.summary: Header-only TOML config file parser and serializer for C++17

topaz.name: topaz
topaz.summary:
topaz: Pipeline for particle picking in cryo-electron microscopy images
using convolutional neural networks trained from positive and unlabeled
examples. Also featuring micrograph and tomogram denoising with DNNs.

topcom.name: topcom
topcom.summary:
TOPCOM is a C++ package for computing triangulations of point
configurations and oriented matroids. It can enumerate all
triangulations, circuits, and cocircuits up to symmetry, using lock-free
multi-threading for efficient performance on modern multi-core systems.

torch-scatter.name: torch-scatter
torch-scatter.summary:
Torch Extension Library of Optimized Scatter Operations. This version of
the package is consumable by downstream users via CMake

torque.name: torque
torque.summary:
TORQUE (Terascale Open-source Resource and QUEue Manager) is an open
source project based on the original PBS resource manager developed by
NASA, LLNL, and MRJ.

totalview.name: totalview
totalview.summary:
Totalview parallel debugger. Select the version associated with your
machine architecture' '.

tpm2-tss.name: tpm2-tss
tpm2-tss.summary: OSS implementation of the TCG TPM2 Software Stack (TSS2)

tpp.name: tpp
tpp.summary:
Tools for MS data representation, MS data visualization, peptide
identification and validation, protein identification, quantification,
and annotation, data storage and mining, and biological inference.

tracer.name: tracer
tracer.summary: Trace Replay and Network Simulation Framework

tracy.name: tracy
tracy.summary:
A real time, nanosecond resolution, remote telemetry, hybrid frame and
sampling profiler for games and other applications. Server applications.

tracy-client.name: tracy-client
tracy-client.summary:
A real time, nanosecond resolution, remote telemetry, hybrid frame and
sampling profiler for games and other applications. Client library.

tramonto.name: tramonto
tramonto.summary: Tramonto: Software for Nanostructured Fluids in Materials and Biology

transabyss.name: transabyss
transabyss.summary: De novo assembly of RNAseq data using ABySS

transdecoder.name: transdecoder
transdecoder.summary:
TransDecoder identifies candidate coding regions within transcript
sequences, such as those generated by de novo RNA-Seq transcript
assembly using Trinity, or constructed based on RNA-Seq alignments to
the genome using Tophat and Cufflinks.

transferbench.name: transferbench
transferbench.summary:
TransferBench is a utility capable of benchmarking simultaneous copies
between user-specified devices (CPUs/GPUs)

transposome.name: transposome
transposome.summary:
A toolkit for annotation of transposable element families from
unassembled sequence reads.

transrate.name: transrate
transrate.summary:
Transrate is software for de-novo transcriptome assembly quality
analysis.

transset.name: transset
transset.summary: transset is an utility for setting opacity property.

tree.name: tree
tree.summary:
Tree is a recursive directory listing command that produces a depth
indented listing of files, which is colorized ala dircolors if the
LS_COLORS environment variable is set and output is to tty. Tree has
been ported and reported to work under the following operating systems:
Linux, FreeBSD, OS X, Solaris, HP/UX, Cygwin, HP Nonstop and OS/2.

tree-sitter.name: tree-sitter
tree-sitter.summary:
Tree-sitter is a parser generator tool and an incremental parsing
library. It can build a concrete syntax tree for a source file and
efficiently update the syntax tree as the source file is edited.

treelite.name: treelite
treelite.summary:
Treelite is a model compiler for efficient deployment of decision tree
ensembles.

treesub.name: treesub
